content_sections.heading: ICMR-CCP Senior Resident (Pathology) Overview
content_sections.text: The official notification does not mention an application fee.

rows.details: ICMR-Centre for Cancer Pathology, Safdarjung Hospital Campus, New Delhi

content_sections.heading: About ICMR-CCP Senior Resident (Pathology)
content_sections.text: ICMR-Centre for Cancer Pathology, earlier known as ICMR-National Institute of Pathology, is located at Safdarjung Hospital Campus, New Delhi - 110029. The notice describes it as a premier research institute of the ICMR involved in pathology research, diagnostics and academics. The notice is dated 26 November 2026 and was issued in Hindi and English; in case of any discrepancy, the English version prevails.

content_sections.heading: Department-wise Vacancies
content_sections.text: The notice advertises a single post of Senior Resident in Pathology, and that post is reserved for the OBC category.

content_sections.heading: Qualification and Experience
content_sections.text: The notice also states who is not eligible: Candidates who have already done Senior Residency will not be eligible to apply. Candidates who do not have MD/DNB/DCP certificates and/or are awaiting results will not be eligible. The age must be not exceeding 45 years. The notice does not print a date on which age is counted. Candidates should check the official notification for the full eligibility conditions of the post.

rows.qualification: Essential: MD (Pathology)/DNB (Pathology) (Should have completed within last 3 yrs)

rows.relaxation: Up to 5 years, in accordance with instructions issued by the Dept. of Personnel and Training from time to time
The prescribed age may be relaxed in exceptional cases

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms
content_sections.text: Pay: 7th CPC Pay Matrix Level-11. Allowances: allowances as per Central Government Rules are admissible on this pay scale. Non-practicing allowance: admissible to medical graduates as per rules. Private practice: not allowed. Tenure: the tenure of Senior Resident is tenable for 3 (Three) years; however, it is renewable on yearly basis. Accommodation: no hostel accommodation is available. Place of work: ICMR-Centre for Cancer Pathology, Safdarjung Hospital Campus, New Delhi. The notice does not mention the in-hand salary.

content_sections.heading: ICMR-CCP Senior Resident (Pathology) Job Description
content_sections.text: As per the "Job Requirement" printed in the notice, the selected candidate will be required to: undertake routine responsibilities in the Pathology Lab; actively participate in the ongoing academic activities at the Institute.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for ICMR-CCP Senior Resident (Pathology)
content_sections.text: Applications are accepted by email only. The notice gives these steps: Fill in your application in the prescribed application form. Send the application to the email ID [email protected] . Make sure it is sent on or before the last date, 15 December 2026 . The prescribed application form is not attached to this notice. After the last date, applications will be shortlisted, and the interview date will be notified by email only to the shortlisted candidates. The notice does not give the interview venue or time.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in ICMR-CCP Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There is one post of Senior Resident (Pathology), and it is reserved for OBC.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for the ICMR-CCP Senior Resident (Pathology) post?
faq.answer: The last date for submission of the application is 15 December 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What qualification is required for ICMR-CCP Senior Resident (Pathology)?
faq.answer: Candidates need MD (Pathology)/DNB (Pathology), completed within the last 3 years. Candidates who do not have MD/DNB/DCP certificates or are awaiting results are not eligible.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for the ICMR-CCP Senior Resident post?
faq.answer: The age must be not exceeding 45 years, relaxable up to 5 years for OBC (Non Creamy Layer) candidates as per DoPT instructions.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary of ICMR-CCP Senior Resident (Pathology)?
faq.answer: The post is in the 7th CPC Pay Matrix Level-11, with allowances as per Central Government Rules and non-practicing allowance for medical graduates as per rules.

faq.question: Q6. How do I apply for the ICMR-CCP Senior Resident (Pathology) post?
faq.answer: Send your application in the prescribed application form to [email protected] by 15 December 2026.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for ICMR-CCP Senior Resident (Pathology)?
faq.answer: Applications are shortlisted, and the interview date will be notified by email only to the shortlisted candidates.

faq.question: Q8. Who can get age relaxation for this post?
faq.answer: OBC (Non Creamy Layer) candidates get up to 5 years, and the prescribed age may be relaxed in exceptional cases for experienced and qualified candidates.

faq.question: Q9. Can a candidate who has already done Senior Residency apply?
faq.answer: No. Candidates who have already done Senior Residency will not be eligible to apply.

faq.question: Q10. Is the ICMR-CCP Senior Resident post permanent?
faq.answer: No. The tenure of Senior Resident is tenable for 3 (Three) years and is renewable on yearly basis.
